'''Meex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Rebel elite commando/Legends|Rebel Elite Commando]]. He accompanied [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Kiva]] on a mission to stop [[Project Starscream]].

==Biography==
Meex trained with Rebel soldiers and quickly climbed the ranks. On a mission to Kiva, he was in charge of baby-sitting [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], and the baby, [[Eppon]]. Mysteriously two men under his command, Tino and [[Bergan]], died and their bodies were nowhere to be seen. He went on but was later killed by Eppon. Eppon touched Meex's skin, which changed to liquid and Eppon drank it and grew on. Eppon was the first soldier in the [[Army of Terror]].<ref name="Galaxy of Fear:Army of Terror">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Army of Terror]]''</ref>
